meta.useLimits: Sales-design reference. Not purchase-ready SKUs, not engineering or code approval. Rules are reference-only and must not be enforced or ordered from without production verification.
changesV1_1: Added basis/sourceTier to every record; replaced salesVisibility (default/more-options/hidden) with salesListing (listed / listed-with-notice / hold) + salesPriority. No product is held back for being less popular.
Voyage and Dark Slate thickness 7/8 in now confirmed by product pages; Summit thickness still unverified (marked per field).
Added discontinued Deckorators lines (Vault, Distressed, Tropics, Trailhead, Pioneer) for reference only; not sold.
Shared decking standard (owner, 11 Nov 2026) referenced; brand exception report added (5 items).
Complete decking standards (11 Nov, second package): RD-01, RD-05, RD-06 applied; quoteEligible added (listing vs quote eligibility kept separate).

basis.aos-design: AOS design concept or AOS choice; not a manufacturer product
basis.retail-example: Seen at a retailer; not manufacturer data
basis.earlier-research: Carried from AOS planning research; not re-checked

status.verified: Confirmed against an official primary source in this pass
status.listed-unconfirmed: Appears in an official source but ambiguous or incomplete
status.secondary-source: Matches a secondary summary; primary text not read
status.aos-decision: AOS design decision still to be made or confirmed. No manufacturer data exists
status.owner-approved: AOS design choice approved by the owner (sales design). Not construction approval
status.pending-verification: Structural, hardware, supplier or code detail that must be verified before construction use

statusModel.fieldStatus: Overrides status for individual fields of a record (e.g. a profile whose width is verified but thickness is not).

salesListing.listed-with-notice: Shown with a short notice (availability, restriction or code note)
salesListing.hold: Not shown until the stated reason is resolved

statusModel.salesPriority: Optional AOS ordering for frequently used products (sorted first). Never hides products.

changesV1_2: v1.2 (11 Nov 2026): owner decision closure D-01..D-08 recorded where it applies; version labels updated. No product IDs removed or renamed.

exceptions.finding: Voyage 8 and 11-1/4 in, Summit 11-1/4 in (7/16 in thick); Vista 8 and 11-1/4 in, Venture 11-1/4 in (1/2 in thick); 12 ft; in each line's colors.
No riser board is named by Deckorators (retailers sell the 8 in fascia as 'fascia & riser'; not manufacturer-confirmed). Summit and Venture have no 8 in board.
exceptions.salesBehavior: Riser visual from fascia, marked 'selection/technical review required'.

exceptions.finding: Dedicated 11-1/4 in step treads only in Voyage Khaya, Voyage Tundra and Dark Slate. Other colors: solid-edge deck boards, which Deckorators calls ideal for stair treads.
Dark Slate Picture Frame Board is an approved contrast border for all Deckorators decking except Venture. Venture is 15/16 in vs 7/8 in for the others.
